title: Naked DoorDash driver caught on camera disturbs Texas family: ‘Vulgar and completely unacceptable’
text:

Maybe he thought it was strip steak?

A Houston dad got a shocking surprise when a DoorDash driver delivered food to him and his daughter while as naked as a jaybird.

Kiante Matlock said he was inside his home playing video games with his daughter Monday when he got a phone notification alerting him the order had arrived.

But when he checked his Ring camera, he realized to his horror that the driver who dropped off the food was stark naked.

The incredible footage showed the driver, who had shoulder-length dreadlocks, placing their order on the front porch and then casually walking back to his car like nothing was out of the ordinary.

Matlock, who said he uses the delivery service fairly regularly, said he couldn’t believe what he was seeing was real.

He discarded the food and reached out to DoorDash, which was equally appalled at the situation and refunded his money.

“What this consumer experienced was abhorrent, and we’ve reached out directly to offer our support. This man’s behavior was vulgar and completely unacceptable, and as soon as we were made aware, our team permanently removed their access to our platform,” the company said in a statement to Fox 26 Houston.

“We do not tolerate sexual harassment or misconduct of any kind, and we stand ready to assist law enforcement with any investigation.”

DoorDash suggested any customer who feels unsafe over a driver’s conduct should call 911, and pointed Matlock to additional safety resources on the company’s website.

The bizarre incident wasn’t the first time a DoorDasher was caught on camera breaking the rules.

Last December, a Florida delivery driver was caught shoving a stray chicken wing back into a takeout container after it plopped onto the concrete — and licked the sauce from his fingers before walking away without a word to the customers.

A few weeks later, a Dasher tried to pull a fast one by immediately marking a customer’s order as delivered and submitting an AI-generated photo of the food on their front step.
